لَوْطٌ A thing cleaving, sticking, or adhering: an inf. n. used as an epithet. (K.) ―
-b2- [Hence the saying,] إِنِّى لَأَجِدُ لَهُ فِى قَلْبِى لَوْطًا (assumed tropical:) Verily I feel for him, in my heart, a love cleaving thereto; as also لَيْطًا; (S, TA;) and ↓ لَوْطَةً ; and ↓ لُوطَةً . (Lh, Kr.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
